Marked project-timeline segments reject because this action does not define segment insertion or project-wide ripple behavior. Unknown `layer_id` is an error (`InvalidInput`); unknown `composition_id` returns `FxCompositionNotFound`.

JBMaterialGraphNode3D.title: JBMaterialGraphNode3D

JBMaterialGraphOperation3DCurvature.description: Static-source curvature as Vector2 (convex, concave), extracted through channels 0 and 1. The baked field moves with deformation; mesh density limits resolution. Boundaries have no artificial rim; nonmanifold vertices remain zero and do not transmit smoothing.

contrast.description: Positive finite sensitivity: clamp(radius * contrast * curvature, 0, 1).
contrast.title: Contrast

radius.description: Positive finite geodesic smoothing radius in undeformed source units, before object transforms. Object scaling scales the baked map too.
radius.title: Radius

JBMaterialGraphOperation3DCurvature.title: JBMaterialGraphOperation3DCurvature

JBMaterialGraphOperation3DFacing.description: Scalar `pow(max(dot(N, V), 0), exponent)`: one head-on, zero at grazing angles, the inverse of Blender's Layer Weight Facing. N is the interpolated front-facing shading normal before normal mapping. V points toward this shading event's viewer: camera for raster/primary rays, ray origin for secondary hits, or receiving point for emitter/light-sampling queries.

exponent.description: Finite, positive falloff exponent; omission means 1.
exponent.title: Exponent

JBMaterialGraphOperation3DFacing.title: JBMaterialGraphOperation3DFacing

JBMaterialGraphOperation3DNormalConvert.description: Convert an already typed normal using the evaluated geometric frame.
JBMaterialGraphOperation3DNormalConvert.title: JBMaterialGraphOperation3DNormalConvert

JBMaterialGraphOperation3DNormalFromVect.description: Declare a vector's intended normal space explicitly; reject zero dynamically.
JBMaterialGraphOperation3DNormalFromVect.title: JBMaterialGraphOperation3DNormalFromVector

JBMaterialGraphPort3D.description: Output ports have identities independent of their supplying nodes.
JBMaterialGraphPort3D.title: JBMaterialGraphPort3D

JBMaterialGraphTexture3D.description: A stable sampling descriptor, not a transient program image slot.

JBMaterialGraphType3DSurfaceNormalModel.description: Typed normal socket; its space is structural, never a vector coercion.

JBMaterialGraphType3DSurfaceNormalPayloa.description: Typed normal socket; its space is structural, never a vector coercion.

dataEditMode.description: The asset belongs to Model Data: replace it for every user, or give this object new Model Data under `new_data_id`.

JBMaterialVariant3D.description: Owns its identity and inline bindings even while inactive.

meshPacking.description: Mesh-only packet override; absence retains the object's explicit base mode.

JBMaterialVariant3D.title: JBMaterialVariant3D

JBMediaLayerUpdate.description: Partial update accepted only for a media layer.

audioEnhancement.description: Replace or clear the generated enhanced-audio (denoise) source for a video layer's embedded audio. Omission leaves it unchanged. Image layers reject it.

eyeContact.description: Replace or clear the generated eye-contact source for a video layer. Omission leaves the current source unchanged. Image layers reject it.

preserveAudioPitch.description: Replace whether a video layer's embedded audio preserves perceived pitch during TimeRemap. Omission leaves it unchanged. Image layers reject it.
preserveAudioPitch.title: Preserveaudiopitch

sourceRange.description: Replace the authored source selection (the layer setter updates its implicit mapping). Sent with an `assetId` other than the layer's current one, it replaces the media: playback is rebuilt from the window and this selection, discarding the retained clock and any TimeRemap. Echoing the current `assetId` keeps the clock.

volume.description: Replace the embedded-video linear gain. 1.0 keeps the source level; 0.5 is about -6 dB and 0.1 is -20 dB. Omission leaves the current opt-in state unchanged; explicit `null` disables embedded audio.
volume.title: Volume

JBMediaLayerUpdate.title: JBMediaLayerUpdate

JBMeshCornerSelection3D.description: Face corners an operation acts on: every corner at the listed vertices, every corner of the listed faces and the listed single corners.

corners.description: Single corners as `[face, corner]`, the corner counted from 0 in the face's `vertices` order.
corners.title: Corners

faces.description: Face indices; selects every corner of each face.
faces.title: Faces

vertices.description: Vertex indices; selects every corner at each vertex.
vertices.title: Vertices

JBMeshCornerSelection3D.title: JBMeshCornerSelection3D

JBMeshEditOperation3DAddCorrectiveShapeK.description: Add corrective shape key `id` authored against a deformed `pose` of the mesh: `from` (a translate, rotate, scale or base sculpt) is applied to the posed positions, or `targets` gives posed positions directly, and the key stores the base-space offsets that, at weight 1 in that pose, place every vertex at its target. Exactly one of `from` and `targets` is required.
JBMeshEditOperation3DAddCorrectiveShapeK.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DAddCorrectiveShapeKey

JBMeshEditOperation3DAddMaterialSlot.description: Add a caller-minted object slot at a display position. Geometry regions and their assignments remain unchanged.
JBMeshEditOperation3DAddMaterialSlot.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DAddMaterialSlot

JBMeshEditOperation3DAddShapeKey.description: Add shape key `id` (a composition-unique item id) named `name` at `weight` (default 0). It starts empty, or with the offsets that `from` (a translate, rotate, scale or base sculpt) would apply to the base; the base itself is not changed.
JBMeshEditOperation3DAddShapeKey.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DAddShapeKey

JBMeshEditOperation3DAddVertexGroup.description: Blender's Add Vertex Group: an empty group named `name`, unique in the mesh.
JBMeshEditOperation3DAddVertexGroup.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DAddVertexGroup

JBMeshEditOperation3DAssignVertexGroup.description: Blender's Assign (`VertexGroup.add`): the selected vertices (default: every vertex) take `weight` (0 to 1) in `group` by `mode`: `replace` sets it, `add` adds it (at most 1; an unassigned vertex is assigned with it), `subtract` subtracts it from assigned vertices, which leave the group at 0 or below.
JBMeshEditOperation3DAssignVertexGroup.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DAssignVertexGroup

JBMeshEditOperation3DAverageNormals.description: Give the selected corners (default: every corner) the `weighting` weighted average of the normals of the faces around their vertex, or with `keepSharp` only of the faces their smooth group joins.
JBMeshEditOperation3DAverageNormals.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DAverageNormals

JBMeshEditOperation3DBridgeEdgeLoops.description: Blender's Bridge Edge Loops for two closed boundary loops (vertex lists in order, either direction): joins them with a ring of faces wound to match their bordering faces, aligned for the shortest connections and then turned `twist` steps.
JBMeshEditOperation3DBridgeEdgeLoops.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DBridgeEdgeLoops

JBMeshEditOperation3DClearCornerColors.description: Clear the colors of the selected corners (default: every corner): they draw white, and a face whose every corner is cleared stores no colors.
JBMeshEditOperation3DClearCornerColors.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DClearCornerColors

JBMeshEditOperation3DClearCornerUvs.description: Clear stored UVs on selected faces; omission selects all faces.
JBMeshEditOperation3DClearCornerUvs.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DClearCornerUvs

JBMeshEditOperation3DClearNormals.description: Remove the custom normals of the selected corners (default: every corner), so they derive their normals again.
JBMeshEditOperation3DClearNormals.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DClearNormals

JBMeshEditOperation3DClearSeams.description: Clear the listed seams, or every seam when `edges` is omitted.
JBMeshEditOperation3DClearSeams.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DClearSeams

JBMeshEditOperation3DClearSharpEdges.description: Clear specified sharp edges, or all when edges is omitted.
JBMeshEditOperation3DClearSharpEdges.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DClearSharpEdges

JBMeshEditOperation3DClearUv1.description: Remove the stored `uv1` of `faces` (default: every face), so their second set follows `uv0` again.
JBMeshEditOperation3DClearUv1.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DClearUv1

JBMeshEditOperation3DDeleteFaces.description: Delete faces, then the vertices only they used.
JBMeshEditOperation3DDeleteFaces.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DDeleteFaces

JBMeshEditOperation3DDeleteVertices.description: Delete vertices and every face that uses one, then the vertices only those faces used.
JBMeshEditOperation3DDeleteVertices.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DDeleteVertices

JBMeshEditOperation3DDissolveDegenerate.description: Blender's Degenerate Dissolve: collapse zero-length edges of faces with zero or negligible area, merge each collinear sliver's middle corners into the face across its long edge (closing the T-junction), then delete the slivers and the vertices only they used.
JBMeshEditOperation3DDissolveDegenerate.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DDissolveDegenerate

JBMeshEditOperation3DDissolveEdges.description: Blender's Dissolve Edges: merges the two faces of each listed edge, then joins the two edges left at each end between exactly two edges.
JBMeshEditOperation3DDissolveEdges.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DDissolveEdges

JBMeshEditOperation3DDissolveVertices.description: Blender's Dissolve Vertices: merges the faces around each listed vertex into one and removes the vertex; a vertex between exactly two edges only joins them.
JBMeshEditOperation3DDissolveVertices.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DDissolveVertices

JBMeshEditOperation3DDuplicateShapeKey.description: Copy shape key `key`'s offsets and weight as a new key `id` named `name`, placed right after it. Its animation is not copied.
JBMeshEditOperation3DDuplicateShapeKey.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DDuplicateShapeKey

JBMeshEditOperation3DExtrudeFaces.description: Region extrude: each edge-connected group of selected faces moves by `distance` along its area-weighted average normal and is joined to its old outline by new side quads. Negative distances push inward.
JBMeshEditOperation3DExtrudeFaces.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DExtrudeFaces

JBMeshEditOperation3DFillHoles.description: Close every boundary loop of at most `max_edges` edges with one new polygon face, appended in loop order.
JBMeshEditOperation3DFillHoles.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DFillHoles

JBMeshEditOperation3DFlipFaces.description: Reverse the winding of the listed faces, flipping their normals. Corner 0 stays first and corner attributes travel with their corners.
JBMeshEditOperation3DFlipFaces.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DFlipFaces

JBMeshEditOperation3DGradientVertexColor.description: Blender's linear gradient: each selected corner (default: every corner) takes `startColor` where its vertex projects at or before `start` on the line to `end`, `endColor` at or beyond `end`, and the linear blend in between. Points are mesh-local pixels.
JBMeshEditOperation3DGradientVertexColor.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DGradientVertexColors

JBMeshEditOperation3DGradientVertexGroup.description: Blender's linear Weight Gradient: each selected vertex (default: every vertex) is assigned to `group` with `startWeight` where it projects at or before `start` on the line to `end`, `endWeight` at or beyond `end`, and the linear blend in between. Points are mesh-local pixels.
JBMeshEditOperation3DGradientVertexGroup.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DGradientVertexGroup

JBMeshEditOperation3DInsetFaces.description: Individual inset: each selected face shrinks inward by `thickness` (measured perpendicular to its edges, in its plane) and gains a ring of quads between its old and new outline.
JBMeshEditOperation3DInsetFaces.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DInsetFaces

JBMeshEditOperation3DLoopCut.description: Blender's Loop Cut: cuts the edge ring through `edge` (across quads to their opposite edges, in both directions, until the ring closes or meets a boundary, a nonmanifold edge or a face that is not a quad) with `cuts` evenly spaced loops, or with one loop at `factor` of each ring edge measured from the side of `edge[0]`.
JBMeshEditOperation3DLoopCut.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DLoopCut

JBMeshEditOperation3DMarkSeams.description: Mark edges as UV seams. Seams split UV islands for the island tools and packing; they never change rendering.
JBMeshEditOperation3DMarkSeams.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DMarkSeams

JBMeshEditOperation3DMarkSharpEdges.description: Mark actual face edges sharp, canonicalizing unordered pairs.
JBMeshEditOperation3DMarkSharpEdges.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DMarkSharpEdges

JBMeshEditOperation3DMergeByDistance.description: Weld each vertex onto the lowest-index earlier vertex within `distance`, optionally only among `vertices`. Survivors keep their positions; a face pinched at a welded vertex splits into its lobes; faces left with fewer than three corners are deleted, then the vertices only those faces used.
JBMeshEditOperation3DMergeByDistance.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DMergeByDistance

JBMeshEditOperation3DMoveMaterialSlot.description: Reorder display rows without renumbering any consumer.
JBMeshEditOperation3DMoveMaterialSlot.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DMoveMaterialSlot

JBMeshEditOperation3DMoveShapeKey.description: Move an existing shape key to an insertion slot after removal.
JBMeshEditOperation3DMoveShapeKey.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DMoveShapeKey

JBMeshEditOperation3DPackUvIslands.description: Pack every UV island of `uvSet` that contains one of `faces` (default: every island) into the 0-1 square without rotating them. `padding` is the smallest UV gap between islands (half of it at the square's edges); `averageScale` first equalizes texel density.
JBMeshEditOperation3DPackUvIslands.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DPackUvIslands

JBMeshEditOperation3DProjectUvs.description: Write projected UVs into `uvSet` for `faces` (default: every face). `center` and the projection's `size` fit the faces when omitted; `rotation` turns the image in degrees. The same settings as the animatable `uvProject` modifier.
JBMeshEditOperation3DProjectUvs.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DProjectUvs

JBMeshEditOperation3DRecalculateNormals.description: Wind each edge-connected component consistently (Blender's Recalculate Outside): closed components face outward, open ones keep the orientation covering more area. `faces` limits the repair to the components containing those faces.
JBMeshEditOperation3DRecalculateNormals.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DRecalculateNormals

JBMeshEditOperation3DRemoveFromVertexGro.description: Blender's Remove (from group): the selected vertices (default: every vertex) leave `group`, becoming unassigned (weight 0 to every consumer).
JBMeshEditOperation3DRemoveFromVertexGro.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DRemoveFromVertexGroup

JBMeshEditOperation3DRemoveMaterialSlot.description: Remove an unreferenced stable object slot. Reassign its region and variant users in the same candidate before removal, or reject.
JBMeshEditOperation3DRemoveMaterialSlot.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DRemoveMaterialSlot

JBMeshEditOperation3DRemoveShapeKey.description: Remove shape key `key` and its weight animation.
JBMeshEditOperation3DRemoveShapeKey.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DRemoveShapeKey

JBMeshEditOperation3DRemoveVertexGroup.description: Remove vertex group `group`. Rejected on a Mesh3D item while one of its modifiers or a scatter array names it.
JBMeshEditOperation3DRemoveVertexGroup.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DRemoveVertexGroup

JBMeshEditOperation3DRenameVertexGroup.description: Rename vertex group `group` to `name`; on a Mesh3D item, the modifiers and scatter arrays naming it follow.
JBMeshEditOperation3DRenameVertexGroup.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DRenameVertexGroup

JBMeshEditOperation3DRotate.description: Rotate the selected vertices by `angle` degrees about a line parallel to the local `axis` (right-hand rule) through `pivot`, which defaults to the mean of the selected vertex positions.
JBMeshEditOperation3DRotate.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DRotate

JBMeshEditOperation3DScale.description: Scale the selected vertices per axis about `pivot` (default: their mean). Zero and negative factors are allowed.
JBMeshEditOperation3DScale.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DScale

JBMeshEditOperation3DSculpt.description: Apply brush dabs (`samples`) in order, each seeing the previous result, to the base positions or to the shape of key `shapeKey`. A dab moves vertices within `radius` of `center` (mesh-local pixels, straight-line distance), weighted by Blender's Smooth falloff `3t^2 - 2t^3` with `t = 1 - distance / radius`, times `1 - mask`. Topology never changes, so subdivide first where detail is needed.

symmetry.description: Also apply each sample mirrored across these local axes' planes through the origin (every combination, as in Blender). Each mirrored copy is its own dab, so a dab centered on a mirror plane applies twice there.
symmetry.title: Symmetry

JBMeshEditOperation3DSculpt.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DSculpt

JBMeshEditOperation3DSetCornerColors.description: Set linear RGBA multipliers (finite, non-negative; above 1 brightens) at exact face/corner addresses.
JBMeshEditOperation3DSetCornerColors.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DSetCornerColors

JBMeshEditOperation3DSetCornerUvs.description: Set exact corner UVs, materializing omitted values from their fallback.
JBMeshEditOperation3DSetCornerUvs.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DSetCornerUvs

JBMeshEditOperation3DSetFaceRegions.description: Assign selected faces to a declared region of their Mesh Data. The object independently maps this key to a stable material slot.
JBMeshEditOperation3DSetFaceRegions.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DSetFaceRegions

JBMeshEditOperation3DSetNormals.description: Give the selected corners (default: every corner) a custom normal: `direction`, or the direction from each corner's vertex toward the local point `target`. Give exactly one.
JBMeshEditOperation3DSetNormals.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DSetNormals

JBMeshEditOperation3DSetShapeKeyOffsets.description: Replace shape key `key`'s offsets: one local-pixel offset per listed vertex (any order, no repeats). Zero offsets are dropped; empty lists reset the key to the base shape.
JBMeshEditOperation3DSetShapeKeyOffsets.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DSetShapeKeyOffsets

JBMeshEditOperation3DSetSmoothAngle.description: Set the static smoothing threshold, in degrees (0 through 180).
JBMeshEditOperation3DSetSmoothAngle.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DSetSmoothAngle

JBMeshEditOperation3DSetVertexColors.description: Paint the selected corners (default: every corner) with linear RGBA `color`, multiplied into the base color. Selecting vertices paints every corner at them alike (a point color); selecting faces paints whole faces (hard color edges).
JBMeshEditOperation3DSetVertexColors.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DSetVertexColors

JBMeshEditOperation3DSplitFaces.description: Blender's Split: the selected faces get their own copies of the vertices they share with other faces, becoming a separate island in place. They keep their indices; copies are appended.
JBMeshEditOperation3DSplitFaces.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DSplitFaces

JBMeshEditOperation3DSubdivideFaces.description: Blender's Subdivide: every edge of the selected faces gets `cuts` evenly spaced vertices; selected quads and triangles become grids of `(cuts + 1)^2` quads or triangles, other selected polygons only gain the edge vertices, and unselected faces sharing a cut edge gain them as corners, so nothing cracks. New vertices, their shape-key offsets and the new corners' UVs and colors are interpolated linearly.
JBMeshEditOperation3DSubdivideFaces.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DSubdivideFaces

JBMeshEditOperation3DTransformUvIslands.description: Scale, rotate (degrees, +U toward +V) and move every UV island of `uvSet` that contains one of `faces` (default: every island). Scale and rotation act about `pivot`, by default the islands' UV bounds center; a negative scale mirrors the islands.
JBMeshEditOperation3DTransformUvIslands.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DTransformUvIslands

JBMeshEditOperation3DUnwrapUvs.description: Unwrap `faces` (default: every face) into `uvSet` with least squares conformal maps (Blender's Unwrap, Conformal). Islands are cut at seams, mesh boundaries, nonmanifold or inconsistently wound edges and the edges of the listed faces; every island needs a boundary. `pins` are vertices whose current UVs stay fixed. Islands without pins are oriented upright as seen from outside and packed into 0-1 with `padding` at equal texel density; pinned islands stay in place.
JBMeshEditOperation3DUnwrapUvs.title: JBMeshEditOperation3DUnwrapUvs

JBMeshLodLevel3D.description: One level to generate: the copy's identity and the fraction of the source's evaluated triangles it keeps.

newItemId.description: Explicit identity of the level's Mesh3D; its materials, modifiers and shape keys receive fresh identities.
newItemId.title: Newitemid

JBMeshLodLevel3D.title: JBMeshLodLevel3D

JBMeshModifier3DBend.description: Circular-arc bend of the incoming mesh along a local spine axis. Geometry outside the affected range follows the range ends rigidly.

angle.description: Total bend in degrees across the affected range.
angle.title: Angle

direction.description: Degrees about the spine (right-hand rule) from the next cyclic axis to the direction the spine curves toward.
direction.title: Direction

invertVertexGroup.description: Use one minus each weight (Blender's Invert). Plain.
invertVertexGroup.title: Invertvertexgroup

lower.description: One end of the affected range, as a fraction of the incoming extent.
lower.title: Lower

pivot.description: Fixed cross-section, as a fraction of the incoming spine extent; clamped into the affected range.
pivot.title: Pivot

upper.description: Other end of the affected range, as a fraction of the incoming extent.
upper.title: Upper

vertexGroup.description: Vertex group whose weight scales the effect at each vertex (Blender's Vertex Group): one of the editable base mesh's, or one a vertex-group data transfer earlier in the stack provides (on a primitive mesh too). 1 is the full effect, 0 or unassigned none. Omitted, every vertex takes the full effect. Plain, not animatable.
vertexGroup.title: Vertexgroup

JBMeshModifier3DBend.title: JBMeshModifier3DBend

JBMeshModifier3DBevel.description: Chamfers or rounds the incoming mesh's sharp edges with a strip of profile segments, and patches corners where three or more meet.

limitAngle.description: Edges whose two faces' normals differ by more than this many degrees are beveled (0 for coplanar faces). Plain, not animatable.
limitAngle.title: Limitangle

profile.description: Profile shape in `0..=1`: 0.5 circular, 0.25 straight, 1 square and below 0.25 concave.

Accepted on read only, for documents persisted before the migration shipped - real PROD projects still carry this shape, so `project_extract_assets` hard-failed parsing them with a `deny_unknown_fields` "unknown field `path`" error. Round-trips as-is (a legacy mask that is loaded and re-saved untouched keeps working) since there is no sibling shape layer to migrate it onto; `masks::evaluate_path_masks` uses it directly - unlike `Self::layer`, it needs no per-frame lookup against a guide layer or affine remap into the consumer's local space, since it was already authored there. Mutually exclusive with `Self::layer` in practice: an old document has this and no `layer`; every document written by this build (or read back unmodified) has exactly one of the two.

brush.description: The brush. - `draw`: Pushes every vertex `strength` pixels along one direction: the unit `direction` when given, else the falloff-weighted average normal of the vertices under the brush (Blender's area normal; rejected when it cancels). Negative digs in. - `grab`: Moves vertices by `direction * strength`. - `inflate`: Pushes each vertex `strength` pixels along its own normal: the shape swells (negative: deflates) in every direction. A vertex without a normal (loose, or only on zero-area faces) stays put. - `smooth`: Moves each vertex `strength` of the way toward the mean of its edge neighbors (boundary vertices: their boundary neighbors; open corners stay), so `strength` is a fraction in `0..=1`. One relaxation step per dab.
